title: Account1's Soggy Cat over Totem of Undying
description: Changes the Totem of Undying for Soggy Cat.
body:
Changes the Totem of Undying to Soggy Cat, with a custom sound effect too(made by me and myself)

This was made after a friend requested me to do so, which I did for fun

Yeah have fun with this tiny resource pack, and probably my only project.
